summary: Condition survey report for Ledpettie Bridge (LB 5574) submitted under Scope S 245 item 8.1.
PM acknowledges receipt of the bridge condition survey report. No comment on condition or Scope.

Bridge in very poor condition. Scope limited to vibration monitoring, hoarding and minor repairs; structure may need additional support during adjacent works and minor repairs may not be a long-term solution.

PM relies on Scope S 320 13.4.14.3: Contractor must ensure the listed structure is not affected without written consent of the heritage bodies. No change to the Scope instructed. (Source: project team summary.)
Method statement (RAMS 0049) for vibration monitoring at LB 5574 issued for information.

Special structural inspection: bridge in very poor condition; Scope remedials (S 320 13.4.14.8(v)) unlikely to ensure stability; structure could collapse in the short to medium term even without the A9 works.
Baseline vibration data and specialist acoustic consultant's proposed vibration threshold submitted.
PM has no objection in principle to the vibration threshold, subject to agreement and consent of the local authority (S 320 13.4.14.8 (iii)-(iv)); asks for a detailed method statement.
Contractor: temporary works needed are above the Scope. PM disagrees. Action: PM to consider whether the permanent works specification for the structure should be changed.
Bats species protection plan for Ledpettie Bridge not accepted; comments to address before acceptance.

Following joint site visit with the local authority heritage officer (15 Jul 2026, letter 22 Jul 2026): Contractor concerned the Scope (S 320 13.4.14.8) may not be fit for purpose given severe deterioration and risk of collapse; requests meeting with PM.

After meeting of 14 Aug 2026, Contractor seeks further structural assessment by a conservation engineer and reserves its rights to recover time and cost. NOTE: a reservation of rights is not a cl. 61.3 notification.

Conservation engineer interim feedback: parapet collapse risk, arch barrel cracking, root damage; recommends parapet downtaking before piling and 2-5 mm/s vibration limit. TWD not completed or accepted. Asks PM to confirm intent for the bridge (maintain or improve) - reply requested by 28 Sep 2026.
PM notes a new works notice and Listed Building Consent will likely be required; Contractor notes Traffic Switch 1 is at risk; PM states the Scope includes the temporary works required.
Conservation engineer's final structural report on Ledpettie Bridge submitted.
PM acknowledges interim feedback and states the intention for the bridge is as per Scope S 320 13.4.14.3 and 13.4.14.8 - i.e. no change to the Scope instructed.
PM reply to GC-1385 requested by 28 Sep 2026 was not given; PM replied on 5 Oct 2026 (GC-1456). Check the 'period for reply' in Contract Data before relying on this.
Late PM reply to GC-1385 (7 days after the requested date).
